title: ChatGPT agent plans a family's week of meals and fills carts at two grocers
summary: Aaron Maurer had ChatGPT agent plan a week of healthier family meals under $300, write recipes and snacks, compare prices and build carts at Hy-Vee and Fareway, recording the run on video.
agent_role: The agent planned meals and browsed store sites to build carts; Maurer verified logins and adjusted items before checkout.
